line: vertical line at x = 0.5 of the frame (pixel 384); L->R = entry, R->L = exit
method: Each counted event was checked on before/after crops of the tracked person (output/crossings/panels_*.jpg). Missed crossings were searched with a slit-scan of the line column (slitscan_*.jpg) and every unexplained figure was checked on frame strips (check_*.jpg). One annotator.

missed.note: person in white hood crosses next to the signpost; no event
man reaches just beyond the dead band while others cross L->R at the same time

excluded.note: woman walks up to the line and turns back: not a crossing (correctly not counted)
group standing on the line: no crossing until one leaves (event 2)
person reaches the line in the last frames; crossing not completed before the video ends
